evidence: E-06 requires a usable manual host fallback. The current browser bootstrap registers location.origin as the shell hint at packages/web/src/app/bootstrap.ts:111, which takes precedence over the saved manual host in packages/web/src/api/base-url.ts. The prior task commit 7a2c8d9 contained the browser null-hint fix; the current PR head a98b7353 lost it after updating from main.

The patch changes only M9-T25 effective paths: packages/web/src/app/bootstrap.ts and packages/web/test/bootstrap.test.ts are now allowed for restoring the existing E-06 behavior and testing the production bootstrap path. Acceptance criteria and other task scopes remain unchanged. M1-T11 and M9-T27 hashes propagate this upstream path change; their own contracts are unchanged and will be reviewed when implemented.
